subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ and column ‘B’ to write five complete
stimulus: sentence. There are more parts of sentences in column ‘B’ than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B a. We take food i. vitamins b. Costly items of food ii. boars no bad effect c. Lack of knowledge of food we iii. causes various diseases d. Various kinds of food contains iv. to keep our body fit e. By eating from one grout of food we v. may lack nutrition vi. can make us healthy vii. can not keep our body fit.
guide_solution: (a + iv) : We take food to keep our body fit. (b + v) : Costly items of food may lack nutrition. (c + iii) : Lack of knowledge of food we causes various diseases. 40 (d + i) : Various kinds of food contains vitamins. (e + vii) : By eating from one grout of food we can not keep our body fit.
